verdict.rationale: Bland documents batch calls, which start high-volume call campaigns from an uploaded CSV of recipients. That is a real bulk operation, but it is the only one evidenced, and it rests on a single short doc line. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond outbound calling (e.g., bulk management of agents, pathways, numbers or call records), documented API/CLI/MCP-driven batch control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
